summary: Cooperative Angeles NF lookout built 1934, named staff 1938-1951, destroyed in the August 1951 Munz Lake fire and not rebuilt; few concrete blocks remain.

facts.design: California Region revision of the USFS L-4 cabin on a 10 ft open timber tower
facts.status_note: Destroyed in a wildfire in August 1951 and not rebuilt. Only a few concrete blocks and a weather station remain on the summit.

corrections.why: Both sources describe a cooperative lookout between the Forest Service and the county forestry department, not a Forest Service lookout alone.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register lists 4,611 ft (1,405 m); Angeles Adventures lists 4,605 feet. The brief's 1405.4 m matches the register figure.
An August 27, 1951 report says more than 8,000 acres. A later Signal report, quoted by Angeles Adventures, says 9,000 acres. The story gives both.

notes_for_editor: History is well sourced across three pages. Today's site description rests on one hobby site (Angeles Adventures), which cites a 1951 Signal story; no official site record was checked. Access and visitor status were not found in any source read, so none is stated. Photos are not added: the register captions name USC Digital Library and National Archives images, but no image URLs were found.
